pieces.Text: A varculak imparts the leech critical hit effect (Starfinder Armory 31) to any melee weapon it wields, but the saving throw DC is 10 + the varculak's level + its Strength modifier, and the duration of the effect is 1d4 rounds. In addition, when a creature fails its save against this leech critical hit effect, the varculak regains a number of Hit Points equal to half its CR or level (minimum 0). If the weapon already has a critical hit effect, the varculak must choose which to apply on a critical hit.
